paragraphs.text: Tomoya (TOH-moh-yah) the Revealer was a human wizard from Kamigawa who was active during the Kami War .

Before he became the Revealer, Tomoya was a simple jushi apprentice in Minamo . After he reached master jushi status with expertise in prophesying magic , Tomoya wore an elaborate costume including a brocaded blue montsuki, a giant bronze headpiece with a gridded face mask, and a tatami chestguard.
